tracks.name: Business Analytics & Intelligence
tracks.tagline: Turn raw data into decisions leadership actually uses.
tracks.desc: Analyze business data and build dashboards for decision-making.

faq.a: With the current scholarship, the total programme fee is ₹8,000 (list price ₹24,999). You reserve your seat with a ₹1,065 registration fee, and your counsellor shares the payment schedule.

Live classes, lifetime LMS access to every recording, an internship offer letter on enrolment, domain community groups with news and cheat sheets, 1 major + 2 minor industry projects on real case studies, course, project and internship completion certificates, and an LOR.

faq.a: Yes. Classes are live and every session is recorded to the LMS, so you can catch up around your timetable, exams and placement prep.

faq.q: Do I keep access to the recordings?
faq.a: Yes. Recordings stay on the LMS portal with lifetime access.
All three projects (two minor, one major) are industry-level and based on real case studies.

faq.q: Which track should I pick as an MBA or BBA student?
faq.a: Take the 30-second career quiz, or request a free roadmap. A mentor will map a track to your specialisation and goal.
